passages.title: The cup return experiment
passages.text:
A university cafeteria offered a discount to students who returned reusable cups. During the first week, staff counted 240 returned cups; in the second, they counted 310. The manager praised the discount as a success. However, the second week included a popular campus festival, when more people visited the cafeteria than usual.

To evaluate the programme, students suggested recording the total number of drinks sold as well as returned cups. A rise in returns would be more informative if the proportion of drinks served in reusable cups also increased. They also wanted to know whether customers brought cups back more than once, because repeated use mattered more than a single return. The manager agreed to collect data for another month before changing the discount.

passages.title: The river notebook
passages.text:
Sari interviewed people who lived along a river for a school project. Several older residents remembered swimming there as children, while newer residents mainly discussed the traffic on a bridge nearby. Sari initially wrote that the river had lost its importance to the community.

Her teacher asked whether memories of recreation and present-day observations of traffic measured the same thing. Sari realized that the river still supplied water to vegetable gardens and served as a route for small fishing boats. She revised her report to distinguish changes in how people described the river from changes in how they used it. The interviews were valuable, but they represented different experiences rather than a complete history.

choices: Jumlah pengembalian meningkat tetapi perlu konteks untuk menilai program diskon.
questions.explanation: Perbandingan total dan proporsi diperlukan untuk menilai dampak sebenarnya.
questions.evidence: A rise in returns would be more informative if the proportion of drinks served in reusable cups also increased.

questions.prompt: Faktor apa yang menyulitkan interpretasi kenaikan pengembalian?
choices: Festival menarik lebih banyak pengunjung pada minggu kedua
questions.explanation: Jumlah pengunjung berubah secara bersamaan dengan program.
questions.evidence: the second week included a popular campus festival

questions.prompt: Mengapa proporsi lebih informatif daripada angka mentah?
choices: Karena total penjualan mungkin juga meningkat
Karena pelanggan tidak pernah mengembalikan gelas
questions.explanation: Kenaikan jumlah absolut bisa muncul hanya karena lebih banyak minuman terjual.
questions.evidence: recording the total number of drinks sold as well as returned cups

questions.explanation: Proporsi membandingkan jumlah gelas yang dipakai kembali dengan jumlah keseluruhan minuman.
questions.evidence: the proportion of drinks served in reusable cups

questions.explanation: Manajer memilih menunda perubahan sambil mengumpulkan bukti tambahan.
questions.evidence: collect data for another month before changing the discount.

questions.prompt: Apa revisi utama yang dilakukan Sari?
choices: Membedakan cara orang menggambarkan sungai dari cara mereka menggunakannya
Menyimpulkan tidak ada perubahan sama sekali
questions.explanation: Ia menyadari bahwa persepsi dan penggunaan tidak sama.
questions.evidence: distinguish changes in how people described the river from changes in how they used it

questions.prompt: Apa salah satu penggunaan sungai saat ini?
questions.evidence: the river still supplied water to vegetable gardens

questions.prompt: Mengapa kesimpulan awal Sari terlalu luas?
choices: Wawancara menunjukkan pengalaman berbeda, bukan seluruh fungsi sungai
questions.explanation: Sari tidak bisa menyamakan kisah yang sering disebut dengan semua penggunaan sungai.
questions.evidence: they represented different experiences rather than a complete history

questions.prompt: Dalam paragraf terakhir, “represented” paling dekat dengan …
questions.explanation: Kata represented merujuk pada cakupan pengalaman yang tercermin dalam wawancara.
questions.evidence: they represented different experiences rather than a complete history

choices: Mengajak Sari memeriksa apakah dua jenis informasi sebanding
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan guru menyadarkan Sari bahwa bentuk bukti berbeda.
questions.evidence: whether memories of recreation and present-day observations of traffic measured the same thing
